params.summary:
Project-local config, hooks, and exec policies are disabled in the following folders until the project is trusted, but skills still load.
    1. /workspace/.codex
       To load project-local config, hooks, and exec policies, add /workspace as a trusted project in /home/bench/.codex/config.toml.

skills.name: kiro-debug
skills.description: Investigate implementation failures using root-cause-first debugging. Use when an implementer is blocked, verification fails, or repeated remediation does not converge.

interface.shortDescription: Investigate implementation failures with root-cause-first debugging

skills.name: kiro-discovery
skills.description: Entry point for new work. Determines the best action path or work decomposition (update existing spec, create new spec, mixed decomposition, or no spec needed) and refines ideas through structured dialogue.

interface.shortDescription: Route a new request to the right spec path and refine it into a concrete brief

skills.name: kiro-impl
skills.description: Implement approved tasks using TDD with subagent dispatch. Runs all pending tasks autonomously or selected tasks manually.

interface.shortDescription: Implement approved tasks using TDD with subagent dispatch

skills.name: kiro-review
skills.description: Review a task implementation against approved specs, task boundaries, and verification evidence. Use after an implementer finishes a task, after remediation, or before accepting a task as complete.

interface.shortDescription: Review task implementation against spec, design, and evidence

skills.name: kiro-spec-batch
skills.description: Create complete specs (requirements, design, tasks) for all features in roadmap.md using parallel sub-agent dispatch by dependency wave.

skills.name: kiro-spec-design
skills.description: Create comprehensive technical design for a specification

interface.shortDescription: Create comprehensive technical design for a specification

skills.name: kiro-spec-init
skills.description: Initialize a new specification with detailed project description

interface.shortDescription: Initialize a new specification with detailed project description

skills.name: kiro-spec-quick
skills.description: Quick spec generation with interactive or automatic mode

interface.shortDescription: Quick spec generation with interactive or automatic mode

skills.name: kiro-spec-requirements
skills.description: Generate comprehensive requirements for a specification

interface.shortDescription: Generate comprehensive requirements for a specification

skills.name: kiro-spec-status
skills.description: Show specification status and progress

interface.shortDescription: Show specification status and progress

skills.name: kiro-spec-tasks
skills.description: Generate implementation tasks for a specification

interface.shortDescription: Generate implementation tasks for a specification

skills.name: kiro-steering
skills.description: Manage .kiro/steering/ as persistent project knowledge

interface.shortDescription: Manage steering directory as persistent project knowledge

skills.name: kiro-steering-custom
skills.description: Create custom steering documents for specialized project contexts

interface.shortDescription: Create custom steering documents for specialized project contexts

skills.name: kiro-validate-design
skills.description: Interactive technical design quality review and validation

interface.shortDescription: Interactive technical design quality review and validation

skills.name: kiro-validate-gap
skills.description: Analyze implementation gap between requirements and existing codebase

interface.shortDescription: Analyze implementation gap between requirements and existing codebase

skills.name: kiro-validate-impl
skills.description: Validate feature-level integration after all tasks are implemented. Checks cross-task consistency, full test suite, and overall spec coverage.

interface.shortDescription: Validate implementation against requirements, design, and tasks

skills.name: kiro-verify-completion
skills.description: Verify completion and success claims with fresh evidence. Use before claiming a task is complete, a fix works, tests pass, or a feature is ready for GO.

interface.shortDescription: Verify completion claims with fresh evidence

skills.name: imagegen
skills.description: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas.

interface.shortDescription: Generate or edit images for websites, games, and more
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $imagegen to make or edit an image for this project.

skills.name: openai-docs
skills.description: Use for Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, customization, automations, and self-knowledge—including 'you,' 'your,' 'this app,' or 'this coding agent' when they refer to Codex—and for OpenAI APIs/products and ChatGPT Work. Also use for model choice/migration, prompting, SDKs, Responses, Realtime, agents, evals, and Chat/Work/Codex comparisons. Do not use for generic app/software tasks that merely mention Codex.
skills.shortDescription: Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, and self-knowledge; OpenAI APIs and ChatGPT Work. 'You'/'this app' means Codex only.

interface.shortDescription: OpenAI and Codex docs for models, skills, tasks, and setup
interface.defaultPrompt: Use OpenAI Docs for official docs lookup, questions about Codex itself or Codex surfaces, model selection, model migration, and prompt-upgrade work.

skills.name: plugin-creator
skills.description: Create and scaffold plugin directories for Codex with a required `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, optional plugin folders/files, valid manifest defaults, and personal-marketplace entries by default. Use when Codex needs to create a new personal plugin, add optional plugin structure, generate or update marketplace entries for plugin ordering and availability metadata, or update an existing local plugin during development with the CLI-driven cachebuster and reinstall flow.

interface.shortDescription: Scaffold plugins and marketplace entries
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $plugin-creator to scaffold a valid plugin in the personal marketplace, then validate it before handing it back.

skills.name: review-agent
skills.description: Perform a read-only, defect-first review of a specified code change and return every actionable finding. Use when another agent delegates review of uncommitted changes, a base-branch diff, a commit, or custom review instructions.

interface.shortDescription: Find actionable bugs in code changes
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $review-agent to review the requested code changes and return actionable findings.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Create or update a Codex skill with appropriately scoped instructions and any needed supporting resources.

interface.shortDescription: Create or update a skill

skills.name: skill-installer
skills.description: Install Codex skills into $CODEX_HOME/skills from a curated list or a GitHub repo path. Use when a user asks to list installable skills, install a curated skill, or install a skill from another repo (including private repos).
skills.shortDescription: Install curated skills from openai/skills or other repos

interface.shortDescription: Install curated skills from openai/skills or other repos
